gateway.title: ViCare Rooms
gateway.description: Select the gateway with a Smart RoomControl.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ViCare Rooms
reauth_confirm.description: ViCare Rooms needs its own Viessmann authorization. Sign in to the account that contains your existing gateway. Your sensors and room names will be kept.

user.title: ViCare Rooms
user.description: Enter the Client ID of your own Viessmann API client. No client secret is required. In the [Viessmann developer portal]({portal_url}), register exactly `{redirect_uri}` as the redirect URI for this client (without a trailing slash) and disable Google reCAPTCHA.

abort.no_roomcontrol: No Smart RoomControl was found in the ViCare account.
abort.invalid_auth: Viessmann rejected the authorization. Please sign in again.
abort.wrong_account: The authorized account does not contain the existing gateway. Sign in with the correct Viessmann account.
abort.setup_required: Add ViCare Rooms in Settings > Devices & services to sign in. Remove vicare_rooms: from configuration.yaml.
abort.missing_configuration: Configure application credentials for ViCare Rooms first.

init.title: Room names
init.description: Display name per room index (room_N = room N of the Viessmann API). Empty fields use the API name if available, otherwise "Room N". Note: the Viessmann API only provides room names with a paid API package.

application_credentials.description: Create a Viessmann API client with Google reCAPTCHA disabled as described in the [setup instructions]({more_info_url}). Enter its Client ID. PKCE is used, so the client secret is ignored; enter any value.
